sourceTitle: Connect Google Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights
originalTitle: Connect Google Wallet to Gemini for personal finance insights
author: News from Google Team

blocks.text: Personal Intelligence in Gemini securely connects information from apps you already use — like Gmail, Photos, YouTube, and Search — to make your experience more personalized and helpful. Today, we’re adding Google Wallet to the list of connected apps so you can get more tailored responses around personal finance.
blocks.zh: Gemini的个人情报系统 安全地连接了您已经使用的应用程序中的信息 比如Gmail照片, 照片, 照片,(原始内容存档于2017-09-21). YouTube,.和搜索——使你的经验更加个性化和有帮助.今天,我们...我们正将Google钱包添加到连接的应用程序列表中,
blocks.en: Personal Intelligence in Gemini securely connects information from apps you already use — like Gmail, Photos, YouTube, and Search — to make your experience more personalized and helpful. Today, we’re adding Google Wallet to the list of connected apps so you can get more tailored responses around personal finance.

blocks.text: Understand and plan your finances with Google Wallet
blocks.zh: 理解并计划您的财务 与谷歌钱包
blocks.en: Understand and plan your finances with Google Wallet

blocks.text: Rolling out today for all Gemini app users in the U.S., you can connect Google Wallet for responses informed by your spending habits. You also have the option to securely link your financial accounts from your credit cards and banks to Wallet via Plaid to unlock deeper insights.
blocks.zh: 今天在美国推出Gemini应用软件的用户您可以连接 Google 钱包, 以了解您的支出习惯。你也可以选择从你的信用卡和银行 安全地连接你的财务账户 通过Plaid 打开更深入的洞察力。
blocks.en: Rolling out today for all Gemini app users in the U.S., you can connect Google Wallet for responses informed by your spending habits. You also have the option to securely link your financial accounts from your credit cards and banks to Wallet via Plaid to unlock deeper insights.

blocks.text: Jump into Gemini and tag @Google Wallet to ask questions around personal finance, budgeting and more. Here are some things to try:
blocks.zh: 跳入Gemini并标记@Google钱包,预算编制和其他预算。这里有一些东西要尝试:
blocks.en: Jump into Gemini and tag @Google Wallet to ask questions around personal finance, budgeting and more. Here are some things to try:

blocks.text: Visualize spending: Questions like “can we review my spending from last quarter so I can save $1,000 over the next three months?” enable Gemini to generate dynamic charts tracking cash flow, asset allocation, and budgets directly in your chat.
blocks.zh: 可视化支出 :例如“我们可以回顾我上季度的支出,这样我就可以在今后三个月中节省1 000美元?” 让Gemini能够生成动态图表,跟踪现金流,资产分配,和预算直接在您的聊天。
blocks.en: Visualize spending: Questions like “can we review my spending from last quarter so I can save $1,000 over the next three months?” enable Gemini to generate dynamic charts tracking cash flow, asset allocation, and budgets directly in your chat.

blocks.text: Find forgotten subscriptions: If you ask "what subscriptions am I still paying for, and did any of them go up in price this year?" Gemini finds recurring charges across your linked accounts and flags price increases.
blocks.zh: 查找被遗忘的订阅 :如果你问"我还付什么订阅费"Gemini发现你连结的账户经常收费, 以及旗价上涨。
blocks.en: Find forgotten subscriptions: If you ask "what subscriptions am I still paying for, and did any of them go up in price this year?" Gemini finds recurring charges across your linked accounts and flags price increases.

blocks.text: Budget for the holidays: When you ask "how much did I spend on gifts and travel last year? Use that to help me set a holiday budget for this year," Gemini will look at your transactions from the last year and suggest a budget tailored to you.
blocks.zh: 假日预算:当你问"去年我花了多少钱去送礼物和旅行?"用这个来帮助我制定今年的假日预算,"Gemini将审视你去年的交易,并提出适合你的预算.
blocks.en: Budget for the holidays: When you ask "how much did I spend on gifts and travel last year? Use that to help me set a holiday budget for this year," Gemini will look at your transactions from the last year and suggest a budget tailored to you.

blocks.text: Google Wallet in Gemini is rolling out across web and mobile, for Gemini app users on both Android and iOS.
blocks.zh: Gemini的Google钱包在网络上和移动上展开在Android和iOS上为Gemini应用程序用户提供.
blocks.en: Google Wallet in Gemini is rolling out across web and mobile, for Gemini app users on both Android and iOS.

blocks.text: We’ve built these tools with security and privacy at the center. If you choose to connect your Wallet (under Connected Apps in Personal Intelligence settings), Gemini can only read information from your accounts; it can’t move, manage, or invest your money. You decide if and when you want to opt in to this experience, and you can turn the connection on or off at any time. Learn more here.
blocks.zh: 我们以安全和隐私为中心,如果您选择连接钱包( 在个人智能环境下的连接Apps ) ,Gemini只能从你的账户读取信息;它不能移动,管理,或投资你的钱。你决定你是否和何时 选择加入这个经验,你可以随时打开或关闭连接。在这儿多学点
blocks.en: We’ve built these tools with security and privacy at the center. If you choose to connect your Wallet (under Connected Apps in Personal Intelligence settings), Gemini can only read information from your accounts; it can’t move, manage, or invest your money. You decide if and when you want to opt in to this experience, and you can turn the connection on or off at any time. Learn more here.

blocks.text: For Personal Intelligence, we’re also making it easier for you to see and edit what Gemini remembers. Memory Summary gives you a clear, readable snapshot of your saved preferences, interests, and ongoing goals in one place so you always know how Gemini tailors responses for you. You can review and edit anytime. Open Profile > Personal Intelligence > Memory Summary to view, refine, or remove any details whenever you want. Memory Summary is available on web and mobile for all Gemini app users where Personal Intelligence is available.
blocks.zh: 对于个人情报,也让大家更容易看到并编辑Gemini记忆。记忆总结给你一个清晰的,可读取的您保存的首选项快照,利益关系,和持续的目标在一个地方 所以,你总是知道 Gemini如何适应你的反应。你可以随时检讨和编辑.打开配置文件 > 个人智能 > 要查看的内存摘要 ,细化,或随时删除任何细节。内存摘要可在网上和手机上提供,供所有有个人情报的Gemini应用用户使用.
blocks.en: For Personal Intelligence, we’re also making it easier for you to see and edit what Gemini remembers. Memory Summary gives you a clear, readable snapshot of your saved preferences, interests, and ongoing goals in one place so you always know how Gemini tailors responses for you. You can review and edit anytime. Open Profile > Personal Intelligence > Memory Summary to view, refine, or remove any details whenever you want. Memory Summary is available on web and mobile for all Gemini app users where Personal Intelligence is available.
